name: StratLearn - Interactive Business Strategy & Planning Tools
description: An interactive learning and simulation platform for 26 executive frameworks across Strategy & Planning (SWOT, PESTLE, 5 Forces, BSC, Ansoff, Blue Ocean, VRIO, OKRs), Business Model Innovation (BMC, Lean Canvas, VPC, Design Thinking, JTBD, St. Gallen BMN), Marketing & Growth (Marketing Mix 4Ps/7Ps, STP, AIDA, Journey Map, Growth Hacking, NPS), and Operations & Process (Lean Management, Six Sigma, Kaizen, VSM, BPR, Kanban).
